chosenBoundary: Extend the existing OpenAPI, FastAPI dependency/service/model, frontend API client, generated artifacts, and Playwright boundaries; introduce only responsibility-specific modules where the current boundary has a verified gap.
rationale: The repository already has the correct contract-first, generated-type, telemetry, session-auth, SQLAlchemy, Nx, and E2E seams. Extending those seams keeps one source of truth and avoids duplicate clients, authorization paths, model bases, or test harnesses.
negativeSearchEvidence: No existing organization, membership, role-permission, invitation, audit, notification, background-job, MFA, OIDC, or API-key modules were found under the approved application boundaries.

No existing shared abstraction covers the planned organization-scoped resources, so those modules require new responsibility-specific boundaries built on the existing database, auth, telemetry, and API conventions.
No repository-native feature-flag system is present; no new flag framework will be introduced.
